caption: The drawing depicts a long, light-colored (cream or beige) coat shown from the back. The coat features extensive decorative embroidery on the yoke and upper back, with red, green, and possibly blue thread forming floral and star-shaped patterns. There are red embroidered stars at each shoulder and one at the center top of the yoke, with green stems, leaves, and small red flowers extending downward. The edge of the yoke, cuffs, lower hem, and center back seam are bordered with multicolored trim in red and blue. There are long, light-colored fringes attached at the shoulders, lower back, and bottom hem of the coat. The sleeves also show embroidered motifs, including red leaves near the cuffs, and trim similar to the rest of the coat. The signature "Adele Brooks" is inscribed at the lower right side of the drawing. The background is a plain, light, off-white color.
title: Deer Skin Coat
